english_research_meaning: The early chat flow chained Windows UI, a proposed AI conversation service, external platform AI bridge, model, MCP tool choice, external policy check, product capability adapter, deterministic Scenario/Operation, Case, Artifacts and a model-generated summary.
defeater_or_limit: The flow is a conceptual illustration, not installed endpoints or proof that an external policy check can replace Strategy Box application authorization; actual tool access must be evaluated by the authoritative host.

english_research_meaning: The Android sketch reused a shared application contract through an external mobile bridge to show the same cases, approvals, Artifacts and AI conversations as a companion, approvals and notification surface.
defeater_or_limit: Shared semantics need not imply the same bridge, host language, package, UI widgets or full mobile feature parity; no Android implementation or accepted cross-device transport was demonstrated.

english_research_meaning: A short natural-language refresh request was routed to a named CBR Scenario, parameter validation, Job/Case execution, Artifact creation and explanation of structured results.
defeater_or_limit: A router's selection and summary cannot establish correct parameters, executed Job, verified Artifact or a truthful calculation; a registered Scenario name in an example need not be available at every installation.

english_research_meaning: A weekday-refresh chat instruction was mapped to an AutomationDraft, explicit user confirmation, persisted AutomationSpec and a scheduler-owned recurring trigger.
defeater_or_limit: Parsing a time sentence is not scheduling authorization; user confirmation, exact timezone, rule revision, missed-run treatment and scheduler availability remain separate conditions.

english_research_meaning: The source contrasts a qualified no-change observation that ends silently with a later positive source-check, fetch, validation, rebuild, Artifact creation and mobile notification.
defeater_or_limit: An unreachable or unvalidated publisher must not be counted as unchanged; a generated notification is not evidence of a validated source version or completed output.

english_research_meaning: An agent investigating a sudden lending-series movement should locate the canonical Artifact, compare vintages, inspect affected categories and source validation, run deterministic diagnostics and then explain supported findings.
defeater_or_limit: An agent's statistical hypothesis is not source evidence; a large numerical change might be due to publication revision, classification, units, sample coverage or a real economic effect, which the checked data must distinguish.

english_research_meaning: The proposed cleanup flow creates an explicit file plan, shows candidate files, requests a human review, executes the approved plan identifier and verifies actual effects.
defeater_or_limit: Approval of a stale plan is not permission to delete a changed target set; execution outcome can be partial or unknown and requires independent effect receipts, not a successful narrative.
